$comment: Owner-identity scan configuration. This is the corpus rule Paul set on 2026-10-08: NO OWNER AUTH anywhere in a generated site or its corpus record - synthetic demo login with fake users is a wanted FEATURE of some archetypes, but the owner's identity, tokens, session secrets and the viewer/gate mechanism itself must never appear in a site's source. This file lists exactly what the scan forbids. It is deliberately explicit and reviewable: a pattern that is not listed here is not scanned for, so extend it whenever a new owner-identifying surface appears. FAIL-CLOSED: if this file is missing, unreadable or invalid, the scan reports ERROR and the pair is not accepted. Owner: review the identifiers list - it contains only identifiers that are already public (GitHub handle, name, blog domain); add private identifiers (e.g. email addresses) only in a private overlay config, never committed values you would not want public.
